title: Open Values Source v0.1
description: Where a score comes from. It is either a short note, or a citation with a one-line note, a web address and the year the claim was true.

note.description: One line saying what the source shows that supports the score.

source.description: The web address of the source, starting with http:// or https://. It should open the page the note describes.

asof.description: When the claim was true, as a year such as "2026" or a full date.

publisher.description: Who published the source, such as a government agency or a certification body.

accessed.description: The day the source was read, as YYYY-MM-DD.

license.description: The licence the source's data is published under, where it has one.
